import { beforeAll, it } from 'bun:test'
import { TestApp } from '@guren/testing'
import app from '../src/app.js'
import { resetDatabase } from '../config/database.js'
import { Post } from '../app/Models/Post.js'

  await TestApp.fromApp(app)
  await resetDatabase()
  const u = await User.create({ name: 'A', email: 'a@e.com', password: 'secret123' })
  await Post.forceCreate({ title: 't', excerpt: 'e', body: 'b', authorId: (u as any).id, createdAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' })
  const r = await Post.newQuery().with('author').orderBy('createdAt', 'desc').paginate({ page: 1, perPage: 10 })

result:
Both gates pass: `bun run typecheck` is clean and `bun test` is 8/8 green (2 pre-existing tests + 6 new ones), and `bunx guren check` / `--docs` report zero failures.

I added a public JSON feed at `GET /api/posts`. A new `routes/api.ts` exports `registerApiRoutes()` (called from `routes/web.ts` alongside `registerAuthRoutes`) and registers the route as `api.posts.index` outside the `auth` alias group, declaring its accepted query parameters on the route contract via the new `ApiListPostsQuerySchema` in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` (`page` ≥ 1 default 1, optional `author` ≥ 1, both coerced from strings, so `?page=0|abc` and `?author=abc|0` are rejected with a 422 `{ message, errors }` JSON body before the controller runs) plus `resource: { data: [PostResource] }`, the same type-level hint `posts.search` uses, which makes the generated `.guren/api-client.gen.ts` entry carry `response: { data: Array<Data.Post> }`. `PostController.apiIndex` serves it: it counts and fetches in two queries (the query builder's `paginate()` terminator drops eager-loaded relations, and every item needs its `author`), orders `createdAt desc, id desc` for a genuine newest-first feed, takes 10 per page with an offset, serializes each row through the existing `PostResource` (giving `id`, `title`, `excerpt`, `body`, `authorId`, ISO `createdAt`, and `author: { id, name }`), and returns `{ data, meta, links }` where `meta` comes from `@guren/core`'s `paginate()` helper (`currentPage`, `lastPage`, `perPage: 10`, `total`, plus `from`/`to`), with `?author=` narrowing both the list and the total. Tests live in `tests/ApiPostsFeed.test.ts` (pagination, author filter, combined params, empty-author 200, 422 cases, JSON content type), and `docs/adr/0002-public-json-posts-feed.md` records the decision and its trade-offs; regenerated manifests (`.guren/api-client.gen.ts`, `.guren/routes.gen.ts`) are included.
